A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the reaction of N-(2-cyclopent-1-en-1-ylphenyl)benzamide ( 1a ) with HCl gas, TFA, Br _{2} and electron beam (EB) irradiation in gas-phase resulted in the formation of 3,1-benzoxazine ( 2a ) as a single product.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the cyclization of N-(2-cyclopent-1-en-1-ylphenyl)benzamides into corresponding 3,1-benzoxazines is a general reaction, proceeding in solution in the presence of gaseous reagents, such as chlorine, trifluoroacetic acid, and bromine, as well as in the mass-spectrometric conditions under the action of the electronic impact in the gas phase.
